purpose: Catch-up package for the VRAXION night marathon around pocket routing, DNA/genome search, equality, and noise isolation.

experimental_runner.note: Add this file to the GitHub package if reproducibility is required.

strong_positive_control.name: pocket_id_only_direct_evo_9181
strong_positive_control.command_summary: direct VRAXION mutation, seed 9181, train 4000, test 1440, steps 140, candidates 64

incomplete_control.name: symbol_match_only_direct_evo_9182
incomplete_control.warning: Do not treat this as final evidence.

main_findings: Clean wanted-pocket to output-pocket selection is learnable by direct VRAXION mutation.
Current DNS/genome/GA methods did not recover that selector reliably and plateaued around 52-56 percent on long controls.
Symbol equality remains weak or at least not yet proven under direct mutation.
Extra grid/pocket/noise lamps break clean routing in smoke runs.
Do not jump back to full Raven until selector, equality, and noise/gating are isolated.
